author: claude
body: Added in 91ba7fae. The page now says a subagent's wait is a pause too: while one works, the main conversation sends nothing, so a 5 to 60 minute subagent leaves the 5-minute cache cold, the same as a coffee break. Under 5 minutes costs nothing either way, and over an hour both caches are gone. The calculator has a new day, 'Waiting on subagents' (10, 20 and 120 minute waits), and there is a new table in 'What my own logs said' showing what ended each 5 to 60 minute pause. In my logs, 86% of subagents came back in under 5 minutes and only 4 ever took over an hour, so subagent waits are about 4% of the re-write cost. The after picture of the new day is in this thread.
